assets.alt_text: Piecewise-linear graph of f on labeled x and f(x) axes.
assets.long_description: Straight segments connect the points (0,1), (2,7), (5,1) and (7,3), in that order. The x axis runs from 0 to 7; the vertical axis is labeled f(x).

assets.alt_text: Two Pop-only bar panels: freshman counts and senior percentages.
assets.long_description: Freshmen panel: n=200, vertical axis Count from 0 to 200, Pop bar height 60. Seniors panel: n=50, vertical axis Percent from 0 to 100, Pop bar height 40. Only the Pop category is displayed; other genres are unspecified.

assets.alt_text: Equal-total segmented percentage bars for Chess and Art meeting preference.
assets.long_description: Both bars total 100 percent of their own club. Chess: online 40 percent, not online 60 percent. Art: online 75 percent, not online 25 percent. Dark segments denote online; light segments denote not online. No membership counts are specified.
